name: Smart&Start Italia
provider: Invitalia for the Italian Ministry of Enterprises and Made in Italy (MIMIT)
summary: Zero-interest loan for innovative startups with high technology content. In the southern regions, 30% of the loan is non-repayable.
amount: Zero-interest loan for 80% of eligible costs (90% if the team is all women and or under 36), for plans of EUR 100,000 to EUR 1,500,000; 30% non-repayable in southern regions
next_steps: Read the official Invitalia page and check eligibility
Write a plan of EUR 100,000 or more with software, staff and services costs
If approved, incorporate as a startup innovativa within 30 days

name: NIDI, New Business Initiatives Fund
provider: Regione Puglia, managed by Puglia Sviluppo
summary: Grants and repayable loans for people starting a new business in Puglia, with tracks for young people, women, the unemployed and new tourism businesses.
amount: Mix of non-repayable grant and repayable loan. Amounts vary by track, see official page
next_steps: Check the category you fall under on the official page
Ask Puglia Sviluppo whether a sole trader Australian ABN affects eligibility
Apply online through Sistema Puglia

name: Resto al Sud 2.0
summary: Non-repayable vouchers and grants for young people aged 18 to 34 who start a business in the southern regions.
amount: Voucher up to EUR 40,000 (raisable to EUR 50,000); 75% grant up to EUR 120,000; 70% grant from EUR 120,000 to EUR 200,000
next_steps: Check the age and employment conditions on the official page
Confirm the business will operate in an eligible southern region
Apply online with SPID, CNS or CIE and a certified email (PEC)

name: Marchi+ 2026
provider: Italian Ministry of Enterprises and Made in Italy (MIMIT)
summary: Grants that cover part of the cost of registering a trademark abroad, at the EU Office (EUIPO) or through WIPO.
amount: 80% of eligible costs, up to EUR 6,000 per EU trademark (EUIPO); 90% of eligible costs, up to EUR 9,000 per international mark (WIPO)

deadline.note: Applications open 3 Dec 2026 at 12:00 CET; first come, first served

next_steps: Register the company in Italy first, since the applicant must have a registered and operating office in Italy
Hold the trademark and have the EU or WIPO filing dated after 1 June 2023
Apply on the Marchi+ 2026 portal when it opens

name: Fondo Impresa Femminile
provider: Invitalia for the Italian Ministry of Enterprises and Made in Italy (MIMIT)
summary: Loans and grants for businesses led by women in Italy.
amount: Loan and grant on eligible costs; project caps depend on company age, see official page
next_steps: Check the female ownership and board thresholds on the official page
Confirm that a woman holds the required share of the business
Apply through Invitalia

name: ZES Unica Investment Tax Credit (ZES 2026)
summary: Tax credit for investing in machinery, plants and property in the Southern special economic zone. Software development is not the target.
amount: Tax credit on investments of at least EUR 200,000 per project (capped at EUR 100 million per project); 2026 budget EUR 2.3 billion
next_steps: Check the official page for the 2026 communication rules
Confirm the investment is at least EUR 200,000 and sited in the ZES
Ask an accountant before relying on the credit

name: Patent Box (110% super-deduction)
summary: Extra deduction on R&D costs for copyright-protected software, patents and designs. Software must be registered to qualify.
amount: R&D costs increased by 110% for income tax and regional production tax, see official page for the conditions
next_steps: Register the software in the SIAE public register
Keep R&D cost records year by year
Ask a tax adviser how it applies once there is taxable income

name: Impatriati Regime (returning workers tax relief)
summary: Half of employment or professional income earned in Italy is exempt from income tax for several years, for people who move their tax residence to Italy.
amount: 50% of qualifying employment or professional income exempt, up to EUR 600,000 a year; 6 or 7 tax years, or 9 or 10 with a home purchase
next_steps: Check the residence and high-qualification conditions on the official page
Note that business income is excluded
Ask a tax adviser before moving tax residence

name: Zest Group accelerators
summary: Italian innovation group (lventuregroup.com and digitalmagics.com both redirect to zestgroup.vc) listing 7 acceleration programs and 13 investment vehicles across AI, CleanTech, HealthTech, FinTech and other sectors. Terms, eligibility and dates not stated on the home page; a Scouting Ticket and a join form exist.
next_steps: Use the Join Zest Innovation Ecosystem form
Check the Scouting Ticket page
Confirm terms

name: CDP Venture Capital accelerators
summary: Italian venture arm; the site announces Fondo Acceleratori II to strengthen acceleration and pre-seed and seed investment. Apply through pitch.cdpventurecapital.it. Amounts, equity and eligibility are not stated on the page.
next_steps: Use the Applica ora button
Read the Term Sheet guidelines
Check Italian company requirements

name: Sviluppo competenze specialistiche delle PMI
provider: Invitalia for the Ministry of Enterprises and Made in Italy
summary: De minimis contribution for training existing employees in technological innovation and the green and digital transition, for SMEs in Puglia and six other southern regions.
amount: 50% of eligible costs; increased by 20% (micro and small) or 10% (medium) for inter-regional projects; second window budget EUR 12,449,676

deadline.note: Second window 10 Sep 2026 12:00 to 21 Dec 2026 12:00; businesses that applied in the first window cannot apply

next_steps: Register in Anagrafica e deleghe on the Invitalia portal using SPID or CIE
Check the SME has an operating unit in Puglia or another listed region
Prepare the training plan and apply before the window closes

name: Investimenti sostenibili 4.0, Bando 2026
provider: Invitalia for the Ministry of Enterprises and Made in Italy
summary: Grant plus interest-free loan for SMEs in less developed southern regions (including Puglia) investing in sustainable 4.0 projects. 25% of funds are reserved for micro and small enterprises.
amount: Up to 75% of eligible costs: grant 35% plus interest-free loan 40% (up to 7 years); EUR 447.6 million total

deadline.note: Applications ran from 6 Oct 2026 and closed from 7 Oct 2026 because funds ran out; watch Invitalia for any reopening

next_steps: Check the Invitalia notice for reopening
Needs at least two approved balance sheets and ordinary accounting (per the earlier round)
Prepare the 25% own contribution without public funding

name: Start Cup Puglia
provider: ARTI Puglia with Regione Puglia, PNICube
summary: Regional business plan competition for aspiring entrepreneurs and teams that plan an innovative business in Puglia (Life science, ICT, Cleantech and Energy, or Industrial). Coaching is optional. Winners go to the national PNI.
amount: 1st EUR 10,000; 2nd EUR 7,000; 3rd EUR 5,000; 4th EUR 3,000; Green and Blue special prize EUR 2,000

deadline.note: 2026 edition (XIX) closed 4 Sept 2026; the page is marked expired. Next edition: See the official page for the current round

next_steps: Watch startcup.puglia.it for the next edition
Prepare a business plan and executive summary in one of the four categories
Use the optional coaching phase and a university endorsement letter

name: Premio Nazionale per l'Innovazione (PNI)
summary: National startup competition fed by regional Start Cups, for researchers and young talent from universities. 2026 final is in Bari on 3 and 4 December 2026. The page lists no prize amounts or student rules.
amount: Cash prizes from PNICube partners; amounts not listed on the page

deadline.note: 2026 final on 3 and 4 Dec 2026 in Bari; entry is through a regional Start Cup. Next cycle: See the official page for the current round

next_steps: Enter your regional Start Cup (see the PNICube network)
Choose one of the four PNI categories
Watch pnicube.it for the 2027 cycle

name: Italian Angels for Growth (IAG)
summary: Italian angel group of over 300 business angels investing in innovative, technology-intensive startups. Apply through the Dealum form. Looks for a full-time founder, a prototype and initial traction. The official page mentions no fee to startups.

deadline.note: No deadline stated; pre-seed investments currently available

next_steps: Read the criteria on the IAG startup page
Submit the Candida la tua startup form on Dealum
Prepare for a screening meeting with IAG members

name: Club degli Investitori
summary: Italian investor club that backs Italian founders. Startups apply via the Apply with your startup button, which opens a Dealum form. Ticket size and fees are not stated on the official page.
next_steps: Open the Apply with your startup form from the Club website
Check ticket size and any fee with the Club before relying on it
Prepare a deck and traction figures

name: CDP Venture Capital
summary: Italian state-backed venture investor (15 direct and indirect funds). Startups apply through its online pitch portal. The homepage says its accelerator fund supports acceleration, pre-seed and seed investments. Eligibility and ticket sizes are not stated on the pages read.

deadline.note: Open pitch portal, no deadline stated

next_steps: Click Applica ora on the CDP Venture Capital homepage to reach the pitch portal
Read the Strategia and Fondi pages for strategic sectors
Confirm eligibility with CDP Venture Capital

name: United Ventures
summary: Milan VC for innovative tech startups. Founders submit a proposal through the Submit your proposal form (name, company, website, short description, funding needs and a pitch deck). Stage, cheque size and geography are not stated.
next_steps: Read the FAQ on the investment focus
Fill in the Submit your proposal form with your deck
Be ready to describe your funding needs

name: CrowdFundMe
summary: Italian equity crowdfunding portal, authorised by Consob (resolution no. 22885 of 10 Nov 2023). Accepts applications from innovative SMEs and startups. Campaign costs (production, controls, commissions on capital raised, legal compliance) are not given as figures on the page.
next_steps: Contact CrowdFundMe through its site to apply
Ask for the full cost breakdown in writing
Check you meet startup or innovative SME criteria
